description: The UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED initiates the registration procedure for initial registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF under various conditions.

properties.description: Trigger for initiating registration procedure. Includes initial registration for 5GS services, emergency services, SMS over NAS, movement from GERAN/UTRAN to NG-RAN, onboarding services in SNPN, disaster roaming services, and resuming normal services.

parameters: UE determined PLMN with disaster condition

conditional_parameters.EPS security context and a valid native: Create 5G-GUTI mapped from 4G-GUTI, include UE status IE and ATTACH REQUEST message
conditional_parameters.Holds valid 5G-GUTI assigned by equivale: Include 5G-GUTI in 5GS mobile identity IE and NID
conditional_parameters.Holds valid 5G-GUTI assigned by other PL: Include 5G-GUTI in 5GS mobile identity IE and NID
conditional_parameters.SUCI available: Include SUCI in 5GS mobile identity IE
conditional_parameters.Emergency registration: Include PEI in 5GS mobile identity IE
conditional_parameters.Onboarding services in SNPN: Include onboarding SUCI in 5GS mobile identity IE
conditional_parameters.dual-registration mode and EMM-REGISTERE: Include UE status IE with EMM registration status set to "UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state"
conditional_parameters.Supports MICO mode and requests the use: Include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message
conditional_parameters.The UE supports UAS services and initiat: include the service-level device ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and set the value to the CAA-level UAV ID
conditional_parameters.The UE initiates the registration proced: include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the UE determined PLMN with disaster condition
